$comment: Hoodit design tokens. Source of truth is app/globals.css :root — if the two disagree, globals.css wins. Hex values are copied, not computed, so update both together.

paper.use: Page background. The default ground for everything.

paper-2.use: Secondary surface, slightly deeper than paper.

ink.use: All text, all outlines, all hard shadows. Near-black, never pure #000.

cobalt.use: Primary accent. Hood, primary buttons, links, user chat bubbles.

cobalt-2.use: Deeper cobalt for shading inside the hood.

green.use: Robinhood Chain green. Money, charts, the CTA panel.

green-2.use: Deeper green for text on light grounds.

mint.use: Soft green fill. Banknotes, success chips, tags.

salmon.use: The cat's fur. Secondary accent, tape strip, widget header.

blush.use: Deeper salmon. Nose, cheeks, small details.

mustard.use: Highlight only. Coins, step numbers, the tag on the hero poster.

telegram.use: Telegram brand blue. Only for Telegram affordances.

display.use: Headlines and the HOODIT wordmark. Always uppercase, tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em), line-height under 1.

mono.use: Eyebrows, kickers, data chips, captions. Uppercase with wide tracking (0.1em to 0.14em).

shape.$comment-radius: Deliberately uneven corner radii so buttons and chips read as hand-drawn rather than machined.
shape.border: 2px to 4px solid ink on every card, button, and chip
shape.shadow: Hard offset in ink, no blur. 3px 3px 0 for chips, 6px 6px 0 for buttons, 12px+ for posters.
shape.rotation: Cards and posters sit at -1.5deg to +1.5deg. Never perfectly square.

texture.grain: A fractal-noise SVG overlaid at 16% opacity, multiply blend, fixed to the viewport.
texture.note: This is what makes the brand look screen-printed. Flat colour with no grain looks wrong.
